description: JSX components an agent can mount. Kinds match NodeKind and tekto-widgets. Props are forwarded by @tektogui/jsx-runtime. There is no onClick prop; events are host actions (ui.click, ui.type, wheel, IME).

components.name: window
components.description: Root window. Rust helper tekto::window sets page fill, padding, and gap. JSX does not.

props.name: name
props.description: Accessible name. JSX title is an alias.

components.name: group
components.description: Layout box with no paint of its own.

components.name: rect
components.description: Filled rectangle. The Rust banner() helper is a rect named banner, not a separate kind.

components.name: text
components.description: Text leaf. A string child becomes the text.

components.name: button
components.description: Labeled button. Rust button() sets fill, color, font size, and padding. JSX does not, so set those props when the sketch should match.

props.name: name
props.description: Accessible label. Defaults from the text child when unset.

events.name: click
events.description: Pointer click on the node. Agents use ui.click with the stable id. No onClick prop.

components.name: text_field
components.description: Single-line field. name is the label. text is the committed value.

events.name: click
events.description: Focuses the field, moves the caret to the end, and clears a preedit.

events.name: type
events.description: ui.type inserts plain characters at the caret. Not an IME and not Backspace.

events.name: key
events.description: Desktop Backspace and printable keys on the focused field.

events.name: ime
events.description: Desktop IME preedit and commit. AccessKit value includes the preedit.

components.name: scroll
components.description: Vertical viewport. Children keep their height. Paint is clipped. scroll_y shifts them.

events.name: scroll
events.description: Wheel (48px per notch) and pointer drag change scroll_y. Clamped, no rubber-band.

components.name: list
components.description: Column of list_item rows. JSX does not add a scroll parent; wrap the list in scroll when it should clip. The Rust list() helper may insert that scroll.

props.name: height
props.description: Viewport height used by the Rust helper.

components.name: list_item
components.description: One list row. name and text are the label.

events.name: click
events.description: Pointer click. Agents use ui.click with the row id.
